name: Emerson Siega
title: Senior Software Engineer
headlineTitle: I build software that is *simple*, useful, and made to last.
headlineText: Hello, I’m Emerson — a Brazilian Senior Software Engineer with over 16 years of experience, focused on building reliable digital products, thoughtful architectures, and experiences that feel effortless to use.
aboutDescription:
I’ve been building software across mobile, backend, frontend, and embedded systems. Since 2019, I've specialized in Flutter, delivering scalable, high-performance mobile applications for companies in industries including finance, luxury retail, healthcare, and education.

My background in backend, frontend, and embedded systems allows me to look beyond the mobile application itself. I enjoy designing scalable architectures, integrating mobile apps with complex ecosystems, and building solutions that remain maintainable as products and teams grow.
